headline: Is Yum! Brands (YUM) A Bargain As Leadership Changes Raise Fresh Valuation Questions?
summary: Leadership change at Yum! Brands and what it could mean for investors Yum! Brands (YUM) has appointed Nai De Leon as Chief People Culture Officer, effective November 1, 2026, following the planned retirement of long-serving executive Tracy Skeans. This leadership change focuses on global People Culture, including talent, rewards and organizational effectiveness. It arrives at a time when analysts expect the company to report upcoming quarterly earnings of $1.59 per share on revenues of $2.18...

headline: Is Yum! Brands (YUM) Fairly Valued After Solid Q2 Hopes?
summary: Yum! Brands stock has delivered a 25.0% total return over the past 5 years, yet current valuation checks suggest the shares now sit close to what a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view would call intrinsic value rather than a clear bargain or clear premium. With recent attention on expected solid results and ongoing Taco Bell and KFC momentum, the question is whether the current US$151.92 share price already reflects that optimism. A 25.0% total return over 5 years points to steady value...
